parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity or expression; the sodomy statute is a dead letter following the 2007 ruling. No documented border, facility, custody or police targeting of trans visitors; the resident-facing LGR gap does not reach travellers. Worst documented features are tier-3 societal hostility: discrimination and frequent physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities (Nov 2024), deeply rooted stigma, conversion practice, and recent escalating political anti-LGBT rhetoric including death threats from supporters of the head of government (2026). No trans-specific killing data either way. Active civil society, pride parades, and curriculum inclusion mitigate. Thin-data silence on border/custody practice is not proof of safety, but no visitor-facing exposure is documented. Elevated Risk, upper end of the band.
